title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function involves a summation over all data points. Notice how each term inside the summation is influenced by both $$\theta_0$$ and $$\theta_1$$. Think about how changes in these parameters affect the overall value of the function.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\Theta_1$$
text: When taking the partial derivative with respect to $$\theta_1$$, focus on terms in the objective function that include $$\theta_1$$. Consider how the derivative of a constant term with respect to $$\theta_1$$ would behave.

title: Identify the Terms Involving $$\Theta_1$$
text: Which terms in the objective function involve $$\theta_1$$?

title: Simplifying the Derivative
text: After identifying the terms involving $$\theta_1$$, simplify the expression by considering how each term contributes to the derivative. Remember, the derivative of a constant is zero.
